policy.noInference: Categories, counts, values, boundaries, and dependencies are marked complete only when directly supported by current evidence.
policy.productionRule: No assignment, research candidate, or primary review result can publish records without second-person verification and the production release gate.
policy.assignmentStatusMeaning: Assignments are recording work orders, not catalog records.

captureAssignments.whatMustRemainUnchanged: Do not change unrelated player setup values during the assignment. | Keep native labels, indices, or visible unavailable states on screen. | Do not rename, trim, crop, or recompress the master recording after capture.
captureAssignments.objective: Record direct evidence for Xbox console identity, game title/version screens, and account-safe environment context.
captureAssignments.exactStartScreen: Xbox dashboard or College Football 27 title screen before entering Road to Glory.
captureAssignments.exactActionSequence: Start from the Xbox dashboard or title screen. | Open visible game title/version information if the game provides it. | Open console information screens only if they do not expose private account, serial, payment, or credential data. | Return to College Football 27 without changing game settings.
captureAssignments.requiredBeginningProof: Game title or console/game context visible before navigation.
captureAssignments.requiredEndingProof: College Football 27 title or Road to Glory entry visible after environment proof.
captureAssignments.acceptanceCriteria: Game title is visible. | Platform family is visible or directly supported by the recording context. | No private account, payment, serial-number, or credential details are exposed. | Unknown version fields remain unresolved if not visible.
captureAssignments.recaptureTriggers: Version/build text unreadable. | Private account or credential information is exposed. | Only a filename, not visible screen evidence, supports the environment claim.

captureAssignments.whatMustRemainUnchanged: Do not change unrelated player setup values during the assignment. | Keep native labels, indices, or visible unavailable states on screen. | Do not rename, trim, crop, or recompress the master recording after capture.
captureAssignments.objective: Record direct evidence of installed game update or patch state without guessing a version.
captureAssignments.exactStartScreen: Xbox game tile, game management screen, or in-game version/update screen if visible.
captureAssignments.exactActionSequence: Open the least private screen that shows update status, installed version, or latest-update state. | Pause long enough for patch/update fields to be readable. | If no version or patch is visible, record the screen proving that it is unavailable in that path.
captureAssignments.requiredBeginningProof: Screen title or game tile visible before opening update/version details.
captureAssignments.requiredEndingProof: Patch/update/version state visible or visibly unavailable.
captureAssignments.acceptanceCriteria: Visible patch/update/version evidence is readable when available. | No patch value is inferred from date, filename, or memory. | If unavailable, the unavailable state is captured directly.
captureAssignments.recaptureTriggers: Patch/update text unreadable. | Evidence shows a different game or path. | Patch state is inferred rather than visible.

captureAssignments.subcategory: Exact canonical Road to Glory creation path
captureAssignments.objective: Re-record the canonical Road to Glory Custom creation path with direct timestamps and no missing transition steps.
captureAssignments.exactStartScreen: College Football 27 main interface before Road to Glory.
captureAssignments.exactActionSequence: Navigate Road to Glory > setup > journey type selection. | Select the visible Custom/Create Player path only if shown. | Proceed through position, QB selection, Create Player, Player, Appearance, Head & Skin, and Hair menu visibility. | Pause on each meaningful transition.
captureAssignments.requiredBeginningProof: Road to Glory entry path visible from the main game interface.
captureAssignments.requiredEndingProof: Create Player > Player > Appearance path and Head & Skin/Hair menu visibility shown.
captureAssignments.acceptanceCriteria: Every meaningful menu transition is visible. | Mode, creation path, player base, position, and Appearance entry are directly supported. | Unknown version, entitlement, and later-editability fields remain unresolved unless visible.
captureAssignments.recaptureTriggers: A transition is skipped. | A selected path is hidden by blur or overlay. | The clip begins after the canonical path decision point.

captureAssignments.requiredEndingProof: Final Head & Skin row and final visible Appearance row shown with no uninspected scroll region hidden.

captureAssignments.exactActionSequence: Start at the first available Head Template value. | Move one selected value at a time while the native number remains visible. | Pause on every value. | Continue to the final value and show wrap/no-wrap proof. | Repeat the count a second time or visibly document any discrepancy.
captureAssignments.requiredEndingProof: Final selector value plus wrap or no-wrap proof shown directly.

recordingOrder.title: Environment, patch, canonical path, and menu boundary
recordingOrder.rationale: Start with version/path facts before any catalog evidence, then end already positioned at Appearance.

recordingOrder.title: Head Template count and order
recordingOrder.rationale: Head count/order is the highest-impact catalog blocker and should be recorded separately from visual comparison.

recordingOrder.title: Canonical slate and standardized head views
recordingOrder.rationale: Lock stable conditions first, then capture head views without changing settings.

recordingOrder.title: Head & Skin selectors
recordingOrder.rationale: Color/texture/geometry selectors live together and can be captured from the same menu region.

recordingOrder.title: Hair submenu and supported child controls
recordingOrder.rationale: Open Hair once, prove child controls, then capture only directly visible supported controls.

recordingOrder.title: Dependency and body/physique controls
recordingOrder.rationale: Run after baseline selectors are known so dependency tests have a valid comparison point.
